decisions.statement: The part and the declaration are one answer over one reading of the body.
The declaration taken out is the one naming that property.
The part taken out is keyed `parts` rather than looked for under a second key.
A page type that declares a property without parting it loses the declaration alone.
Whether the page type parts the property is read from the index.
A slug naming no page property is refused before the body is read.
A path naming no page type is refused before the body is read.
A page type declaring that property nowhere is refused by its path.
Nothing here writes the type a page type has.
Nothing here reads a page of the type the property was declared on.

definition: one page property taken off one page type and out of that page type's parts
